//: Configuration for a Tiny Tapeout micro tile on ihp-sg13cmos5l.
The die area, pin template, top routing layer (Metal3) and the PDN layers (Metal2 and
Metal3) are set by tt-support-tools for `tiles: micro` and override anything set here.
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
Power, vertical: Metal2 stripes that tie the Metal1 rails together. Standard cells cannot
be placed under them, so there is just one VPWR/VGND pair at each end of the core.
Power, horizontal: Metal3 stripes, VPWR and VGND alternating every four rows, centered on
the row boundaries. The container project connects its vertical Metal4 stripes to them
with Via3, wherever they cross.
No power rings
Save some time
Don't put clock buffers on the outputs
Reduce wasted space
Absolute die size
Clock
MAGIC_DEF_LABELS may cause issues with LVS
Only export pin area in LEF (without any connected nets)
